name: easygenerator-auth
description: Full-stack auth module: NestJS 12 + MongoDB API and React 19 + TypeScript SPA

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix frontend
